description: The Larnaca-Class is a Miskilamo Spacefaring hull originally marketed as a 'do it all generalist.' but horrifically poor sales and an overproduction of hulls lead detractors to label it as Miski's E-11 - But, a short series of modifications later, the hulls were marketed to and became prolific in the Independent Mercenary market. Comfortable crew conditions, a decent-for-its-size armory & all the 'tactical' dressings a Mercenary could ask for, with no questions asked from the dealer. Larnaca-Class are often found creeping across planets, hunting for bounty targets. Or lounging around, waiting for a profitable mark to be posted on one of the many contracting networks.
